interpretation: At one fixed physical exposure duration, every scalar reciprocity exponent multiplies all incident rates by the same factor and therefore has exactly zero normalized-log contrast drift. A different scalar exponent cannot repair this structural limitation.

The bounded log-incident-rate-conditioned exponent field is positive, monotone in rate and time, partition exact and can express the synthetic local contrast effect. Swapping bright and dark conditioning produces a large independent failure control.
This is representation capacity only. The four synthetic parameters are not manufacturer values and cannot be applied to photographs without a controlled time-by-intensity density experiment.
